newsitem.title: USA: United Defense gets $129 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: United Defense gets $129 mln contract.

text.p: United Defense said it won a $129 million, one-year contract from the U.S. Army's Tank-Automotive and Armaments Command to refine the technology of the Grizzly tank.

The Grizzly is a mine-proof tank equiped with an automatic depth control and a power-driven arm. It uses an Abrams engine, transmission, final drive and suspension and is operated by two men, the company said.

Under terms of the contract, the company will refine the Grizzly's existing architecture and automatic depth control systems with an emphasis on cost reduction and performance enhancements, the company said.
The company did not say how much the contract would add to its revenue or earnings. Officials were not immediately available to comment.
United Defense is 60 percent owned by FMC Corp and 40 percent owned by Harsco Corp.
